transcript.en: Good morning and thank you for coming here today.
transcript.zh: 早上好并感谢各位今日莅临。

transcript.en: I'd like to bring you up to date with changes in the school that will affect your children.
transcript.zh: 我想要告诉大家一些学校最新的将对孩子们有影响的改建。

transcript.en: As you know, the school buildings date from various times: some from the 1970s,
transcript.zh: 众所周知，学校的建筑始建于不同时期：有一些建造于20世纪79年代，

transcript.en: some from the last five years, and of course Dartfield House is over a century old.
transcript.zh: 有一些是近五年才有的，当然还有Dartfield House已经有100多年之久了。

transcript.en: It was commissioned by a businessman, Neville Richards, and intended as his family home, but he died before it was completed.
transcript.zh: 它是被一个叫做Neville Richards商人委托建造的，本打算是用作他自己家的住房，结果在完工之前他就去世了。

transcript.en: His heir chose to sell it to the local council, who turned it into offices.
transcript.zh: 他的继承人把它卖给了地方议会用作办公场所。

transcript.en: A later plan to convert it into a tourist information centre didn't come about, through lack of money,
transcript.zh: 之后本来打算把它改建成一个游客服务中心，但是由于资金问题这个计划没有实现，

transcript.en: and instead it formed the nucleus of this school when it opened 40 years ago.
transcript.zh: 取而代之的是在40年前它变成了这个学校的中心。

transcript.en: The school has grown as the local population has increased,
transcript.zh: 随着当地人口的增长学校也在逐渐扩大，

transcript.en: and I can now give you some news about the lower school site, which is separated from the main site by a road.
transcript.zh: 我先给大家介绍一下低年级校区的讯息，低年级校区和主校区是分开的，在路的另一侧。

transcript.en: Planning permission has been granted for development of both sites.
transcript.zh: 两个校区的改造计划都被批准了。

transcript.en: The lower school will move to new buildings that will be constructed on the main site.
transcript.zh: 低年级将会搬到主校区的新建的教学楼。

transcript.en: Developers will construct houses on the existing lower school site.
transcript.zh: 开发商会在现在低年级所在的校区建新的房子。

transcript.en: Work on the new school buildings should start within the next few months.
transcript.zh: 新教学楼的建设将会在未来的几个月内开工。

transcript.en: A more imminent change concerns the catering facilities and the canteen.
transcript.zh: 一个最近的改造是关于餐饮设备和食堂的。

transcript.en: The canteen is always very busy throughout the lunch period -
transcript.zh: 食堂总是在午饭的时候特别忙，

transcript.en: in fact it's often full to capacity, because a lot of our pupils like the food that's on offer there.
transcript.zh: 事实上它也是在满负荷运转的，因为我们大部分的学生都喜欢吃食堂的饭。

transcript.en: But there's only one serving point, so most pupils have to wait a considerable time to be served.
transcript.zh: 这主要是因为只有一个打饭窗口，所以大部分学生就要等很长时间。

transcript.en: This is obviously unsatisfactory, as they may have hardly finished their lunch before afternoon lessons start.
transcript.zh: 这是非常不好的，因为他们可能在下午开始上课前还没吃完午饭。

transcript.en: So we've had a new Food Hall built, and this will come into use next week.
transcript.zh: 所以我们建了一个新的餐饮中心，下周就可以上线运营了。

transcript.en: It'll have several serving areas, and I'll give you more details about those in a minute,
transcript.zh: 那有非常多的打饭窗口，我等下会给大家详细介绍，

transcript.en: but one thing we ask you to do, to help in the smooth running of the Food Hall,
transcript.zh: 但是在此之前，为了让我们的餐饮中心运转的更顺畅，

transcript.en: is to discuss with your children each morning which type of food they want to eat that day, so they can go straight to the relevant serving point.
transcript.zh: 我需要各位家长在每天早晨都问一下孩子他们当天想吃什么，这样他们就能直接去选好的打饭窗口了。

transcript.en: There won't be any junk food - everything on offer will be healthy-
transcript.zh: 这没有垃圾食品-我们只提供健康的饮食-

transcript.en: and there's no change to the current system of paying for lunches by topping up your child's electronic payment card online.
transcript.zh: 对于当前的午餐支付系统我们没有进行任何改变，还是用学生们的可以线上充值的充电子支付卡即可。

transcript.en: You may be wondering what will happen to the old canteen.
transcript.zh: 你可能会想知道原来的食堂怎么样了。

transcript.en: We'll still have tables and chairs in there, and pupils can eat food from the Food Hall or lunch they've brought from home.
transcript.zh: 那还是有桌子和椅子的，学生能把从餐饮中心买好的饭或者从家里带来的午餐带到原来的食堂食用。

transcript.en: Eventually we may use part of the canteen for storage, but first we'll see how many pupils go in there at lunchtime.
transcript.zh: 之后我们可能会把老食堂的一部分用作仓储，但是这还是要优先取决于会有多少学生在午饭的时候过去。

transcript.en: OK, back to the serving points in the Food Hall, which will all have side dishes, desserts and drinks on sale, as well as main courses.
transcript.zh: 好了，还是让我们回到餐饮中心的打饭窗口，这不光有主菜，还有配菜，甜品和饮料在售。

transcript.en: One serving point we call World Adventures.
transcript.zh: 其中有一个窗口我们叫它世界大冒险。

transcript.en: This will serve a different country's cuisine each day, maybe Chinese one day and Lebanese the next.
transcript.zh: 这每天都会供应来自不同国家风味的美食。第一天可能是中餐，第二天可能就是黎巴嫩菜。

transcript.en: The menus will be planned for a week at a time, so pupils will know what's going to be available the whole of that week.
transcript.zh: 菜单我们每次都是提前一周做的，所以孩子们都会提前知道我们下一周供应什么菜式。

transcript.en: Street Life is also international, with food from three particular cultures.
transcript.zh: 街区生活也是国际化口味的，这提供三种特别文化的菜式。

transcript.en: We'll ask pupils to make suggestions, so perhaps sometimes there'll be food from Thailand, Ethiopia and Mexico,
transcript.zh: 我们会征询学生的意见，所以有的时候可能是泰国菜，埃塞俄比亚菜和墨西哥菜，

transcript.en: and then one of them will be replaced by Jamaican food for a week or two.
transcript.zh: 之后的一或两周其中的一种菜式可能会被牙买加菜所取代。

transcript.en: The Speedy Italian serving point will cater particularly for the many pupils who don't eat meat or fish:they can be sure that all the food served there is suitable for them.
transcript.zh: 速度意大利窗口主要是针对一些不吃肉和鱼的学生：他们能被保证这提供的所有的餐品都是适合他们的。

transcript.en: There'll be plenty of variety, so they shouldn't get bored with the food.
transcript.zh: 餐品的种类也是十分多的，所以不用担心会吃腻。

transcript.en: OK, that's all on the new Food Hall.Now after-school lessons.
transcript.zh: 好啦，这就是所有关于餐饮中心的介绍了。我们开始介绍课外活动课。

transcript.en: These are very popular with pupils, particularly swimming - in fact there's a waiting list for lessons.
transcript.zh: 这是非常受学生们欢迎的，尤其是游泳-事实上游泳课有一个排队等候名单。

transcript.en: Cycling is another favourite, and I'm delighted that dozens of pupils make use of the chance to learn to ride in off-road conditions.
transcript.zh: 骑行是另外一个受欢迎的课程，我很高兴的是很多学生利用这个机会在非公路的条件下去学习骑车。

transcript.en: It means that more and more cycle to and from school every day.
transcript.zh: 这就意味着越来越多的学生每天会骑车上下课。

transcript.en: As you know, we have a well-equipped performance centre, and we're going to start drama classes in there, too.
transcript.zh: 就像大家所知道的一样，我们有一个设施完备的演出中心，我们也将在那开展戏剧课程。

transcript.en: Pupils will be able to join in just for fun or work up to taking part in a play - we hope to put on at least one a year.
transcript.zh: 学生们可以只是来这边玩或者慢慢发展成为扮演其中的一个角色-我们希望一年至少会演出一次。

transcript.en: We already teach a number of pupils to use the sound and lighting systems in the centre.
transcript.zh: 我们已经教了很多学生去使用演出中心的声光系统。

transcript.en: And a former pupil has given a magnificent grand piano to the school, so a few pupils will be able to learn at the school instead of going to the local college, as many of them do at the moment.
transcript.zh: 之前的一个学生给学校捐了一个很棒的大钢琴，因此一些学生将来就可以在学校里而不是校外的培训中心学习弹钢琴了，因为他们大部分现在就是在校外学习钢琴的。
